style: .td-shell{font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--text-color);padding:4px 0 24px}.td-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:20px}.td-title{font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-color)}.td-date{font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:var(--text-muted);margin-left:10px}.td-subtitle{font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);margin-top:4px;max-width:600px;line-height:1.6}.td-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end;flex-shrink:0}.td-actions button{border:1px solid var(--border-color);background:var(--card-bg);border-radius:6px;padding:7px 12px;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:var(--text-color);cursor:pointer;transition:background 0.12s,border-color 0.12s;white-space:nowrap}.td-actions button:hover{background:var(--control-bg);border-color:var(--primary);color:var(--primary)}.td-card{background:var(--card-bg);border:1px solid var(--border-color);border-radius:8px;padding:18px 20px;margin-bottom:16px}.td-section-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-color)}.td-section-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:14px}.td-section-row a{font-size:11px;color:var(--primary);cursor:pointer;font-weight:500}.td-section-row a:hover{text-decoration:underline}.td-action-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(140px,1fr));gap:12px}.td-action-card{display:flex;gap:10px;border-right:1px solid var(--border-color);padding-right:14px;min-height:66px;cursor:pointer}.td-action-card:last-child{border-right:0;padding-right:0}.td-icon{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:16px;flex-shrink:0}.tone-orange{background:#fff3e5;color:#dd7d00}.tone-blue{background:#edf5ff;color:#2275d7}.tone-green{background:#eaf8f0;color:#198754}.tone-purple{background:#f2edff;color:#7c3aed}.tone-red{background:#fff0f0;color:#dc3545}.tone-teal{background:#e4f8f8;color:#0ca5a5}.tone-amber{background:#fef5e7;color:#f4a224}.td-action-title{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-color);line-height:1.3}.td-priority{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;margin:3px 0}.td-priority.high{color:#dc3545}.td-priority.medium{color:#e69500}.td-priority.normal{color:var(--text-muted)}.td-link{font-size:11px;color:var(--primary);cursor:pointer;font-weight:500}.td-link:hover{text-decoration:underline}.td-kpi-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(120px,1fr));gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px}.td-kpi{background:var(--card-bg);border:1px solid var(--border-color);border-radius:8px;padding:14px 16px;min-height:80px;cursor:pointer;transition:box-shadow 0.15s ease,border-color 0.15s ease}.td-kpi:hover{box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.08);border-color:var(--primary)}.td-kpi-label{font-size:11px;color:var(--text-muted);font-weight:500;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.3px;line-height:1.3}.td-kpi-value{font-size:28px;font-weight:700;margin-top:8px;line-height:1;color:var(--text-color)}.td-main-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,2fr) minmax(280px,1fr);gap:16px}.td-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px}.td-table th{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-muted);text-align:left;padding:0 8px 8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-color);white-space:nowrap}.td-table td{padding:9px 8px 9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-color);color:var(--text-color);vertical-align:middle}.td-table tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none}.td-table a{color:var(--primary);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500}.td-table a:hover{text-decoration:underline}.td-subhead{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-muted);margin:4px 0;padding:4px 0;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.3px}.td-mt{margin-top:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--border-color);padding-top:12px}.td-badge{display:inline-block;border-radius:10px;padding:2px 8px;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}.badge-pending{background:#fff0f0;color:#dc3545}.badge-scheduled{background:#eaf4ff;color:#2275d7}.badge-transit{background:#eaf8f0;color:#198754}.badge-default{background:var(--control-bg);color:var(--text-muted)}.badge-dispatch{background:#fef5e7;color:#f4a224}.td-right .td-card{margin-bottom:14px}.td-side-item{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-color);font-size:11px}.td-side-item:last-child{border-bottom:none;padding-bottom:0}.td-dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#dc3545;margin-top:4px;flex-shrink:0}.td-side-main{flex:1;font-size:11px;color:var(--text-color);font-weight:500;line-height:1.4}.td-side-meta{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:10px;margin-top:2px}.td-side-time{font-weight:700;color:#dc3545;font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0}.td-status-wrap{display:flex;gap:20px;align-items:center;margin-top:14px}.td-donut{width:110px;height:110px;border-radius:50%;background:conic-gradient(#dc3545 0 25%,#f59f00 25% 45%,#2275d7 45% 65%,#20c997 65% 85%,#6f42c1 85% 100%);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative;flex-shrink:0;gap:1px}.td-donut:after{content:"";position:absolute;width:68px;height:68px;background:var(--card-bg);border-radius:50%}.td-donut span,.td-donut small{position:relative;z-index:1;display:block;text-align:center}.td-donut span{font-weight:700;font-size:20px;line-height:1}.td-donut small{font-size:10px;color:var(--text-muted)}.td-status-list{flex:1}.td-status-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px;padding:5px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-color);gap:8px}.td-status-row:last-child{border-bottom:none}.td-empty{font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);padding:16px;text-align:center}.td-skeleton{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--border-color) 25%,var(--control-bg) 50%,var(--border-color) 75%);background-size:200% 100%;animation:td-shimmer 1.4s infinite;border-radius:4px;height:14px;margin-bottom:8px}@keyframes td-shimmer{0%{background-position:200% 0}100%{background-position:-200% 0}}@media(max-width:1100px){.td-top,.td-main-grid{display:block}.td-actions{justify-content:flex-start;margin-top:10px}.td-action-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.td-kpi-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}@media(max-width:700px){.td-action-grid,.td-kpi-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}@media(max-width:480px){.td-action-grid,.td-kpi-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
script:
const $ = (sel) => root_element.querySelector(sel); const $$ = (sel) => Array.from(root_element.querySelectorAll(sel)); const esc = (v) => frappe.utils.escape_html(v == null || v === '' ? '-' : String(v)); const iconEmoji = {'truck':'🚛','ship':'🚢','droplet':'🪣','users':'👥','clock':'⏱','calendar':'📅','box':'📦','check':'✅','dot':'●'}; const route = (r) => { if (Array.isArray(r)) frappe.set_route(...r); }; const listRoute = {assign_vehicle:['List','Transport Schedule',{transport_status:'Pending Assignment'}],assign_driver:['List','Transport Schedule',{transport_status:'Vehicle Assigned'}],dispatch:['List','Transport Schedule',{transport_status:['in',['Scheduled','Vehicle Assigned','Driver Assigned']]}],today:['List','Transport Schedule',{scheduled_pickup_date:frappe.datetime.get_today()}],inward:['List','Transport Schedule',{transport_type:'Inward'}],outward:['List','Transport Schedule',{transport_type:'Outward'}],deadlines:['List','Transport Schedule',{gate_cutoff:['>=',frappe.datetime.get_today()]}],alerts:['List','Transport Schedule']}; root_element.addEventListener('click', (ev) => { const btn = ev.target.closest('[data-route]'); if (btn) route(JSON.parse(btn.dataset.route)); const list = ev.target.closest('[data-list]'); if (list) route(listRoute[list.dataset.list]); }); function badge(status){ const s = status || ''; let cls='badge-default'; if(['Draft','Pending Assignment','Vehicle Assigned'].includes(s)) cls='badge-pending'; if(['Scheduled','Driver Assigned'].includes(s)) cls='badge-scheduled'; if(['Dispatched','Picked Up','Gate In','In Transit','Delivered','Completed'].includes(s)) cls='badge-transit'; return `${esc(s)}`; } function table(headers, rows, cells){ if(!rows || !rows.length) return '
No records yet
'; return `${headers.map(h=>``).join('')}${rows.map(r=>`${cells(r).join('')}`).join('')}
${esc(h)}
`; } function render(data){ $('[data-td-date]').textContent = data.date || frappe.datetime.get_today(); $('[data-td-actions]').innerHTML = (data.today_actions || []).map(a => `
${iconEmoji[a.icon] || iconEmoji.dot}
${esc(a.title)}
${esc(a.priority)}
${esc(a.action)} →
`).join(''); $$('[data-action-route]').forEach(el => el.addEventListener('click', () => route(JSON.parse(el.dataset.actionRoute)))); const k = data.kpis || {}; const kpis = [['Inward Requests Pending',k.inward_pending],['Outward Export Containers',k.export_containers],['Local Deliveries - Tankers',k.tankers],['Local Deliveries - Trailers',k.trailers],['Vehicles To Dispatch Today',k.dispatch_today],['Completed Today',k.completed_today],['Pending Driver Assignment',k.driver_pending],['Pending Vehicle Assignment',k.vehicle_pending],['In Transit',k.in_transit],['PO Requests Pending Payables',k.payables_pending],['Security Draft DNs Pending',k.security_pending],['Gate Out Pending',k.gate_out_pending]]; $('[data-td-kpis]').innerHTML = kpis.map(x => `
${esc(x[0])}
${x[1] || 0}
`).join(''); $('[data-table="inward"]').innerHTML = table(['Material Pickup','Supplier / Source','Vehicle Type','Driver','ETA','Status','Action'], data.inward, r => [`${esc(r.material_description || r.name)}`,`${esc(r.supplier)}`,`${esc(r.vehicle_type)}`,`${esc(r.assigned_driver)}`,`${esc(r.scheduled_delivery_date)}`,`${badge(r.transport_status)}`,`View`]); $('[data-table="export"]').innerHTML = table(['Job Order Number','Container Type','Port / Destination','Pickup Date','Gate Cutoff','Assigned Vehicle','Status','Action'], data.export, r => [`${esc(r.job_order_number || r.job_order || r.name)}`,`${esc(r.container_type)}`,`${esc(r.port_of_loading)} / ${esc(r.port_of_discharge)}`,`${esc(r.scheduled_pickup_date)}`,`${esc(r.gate_cutoff)}`,`${esc(r.assigned_vehicle)}`,`${badge(r.transport_status)}`,`Open`]); $('[data-table="local"]').innerHTML = table(['Customer / Destination','Job Order Number','Material','Vehicle','Driver','Delivery Slot','Status','Action'], data.local, r => [`${esc(r.customer || r.delivery_location)}`,`${esc(r.job_order_number || r.job_order || r.name)}`,`${esc(r.material_description)}`,`${esc(r.assigned_vehicle)}`,`${esc(r.assigned_driver)}`,`${esc(r.scheduled_pickup_date)} ${esc(r.pickup_time)}`,`${badge(r.transport_status)}`,`View`]); $('[data-list-area="deadlines"]').innerHTML = (data.deadlines || []).length ? data.deadlines.map(d => `
Gate Cutoff - ${esc(d.shipping_booking || d.name)}
${esc(d.port_of_discharge)}
${esc(d.gate_cutoff)}
`).join('') : '
No upcoming deadlines
'; $('[data-list-area="alerts"]').innerHTML = (data.alerts || []).length ? data.alerts.map(a => `
${esc(a.message)}
${esc(a.age)}
`).join('') : '
No alerts
'; const summary = data.status_summary || []; const total = summary.reduce((n, x) => n + (x.count || 0), 0); $('[data-total]').textContent = total; $('[data-status-summary]').innerHTML = summary.map(x => `
${esc(x.label)}${x.count || 0}
`).join(''); } frappe.call({method:'apc_operations.shipping.api.get_transportation_dashboard_data', callback:r=>render(r.message || {}), error:()=>{$('.td-shell').innerHTML='
Unable to load Transportation Dashboard.
Check server logs for API errors.
';}});
